card.name: The start of prescribe/prescription words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word like prescribe or prescription, when it is split up, usually right after doctor, non, co- or a similar start. It also fires on words just before 'prescription' in phrases like 'need a prescription'.

modes.label: Split prescribe
modes.description: The 'pres' piece after a doctor or prescriber, leading into 'cribes' or 'cribing'.
modes.example: If your doctor<< pres>>cribes metronidazole or other medicines

modes.label: Non/co prefixes
modes.description: The 'pres' piece after non, co- or a hyphenated start, before 'cription' or 'cribing'.
modes.example: Allow doctor note permitting use of non<<pres>>cription pain medications

modes.label: Word before prescription
modes.description: A word like need or NEW right before the word prescription.
modes.example: medicines that don't<< need>> a prescription and any illicit drugs you may

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'pres' to build prescribe or prescription words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to spell out prescribe or prescription, especially after the word doctor.
